note.zh-Hant: 保加利亞公國（含 1886 年起由保加利亞親王兼任總督的東魯米利亞）。依 1878 年柏林條約是鄂圖曼蘇丹宗主權下的自治納貢公國，1908-10-05 宣布獨立。形狀沿用獨立後保加利亞沙皇國第一筆紀錄，沒有另外查證 1908 年初的邊界細節。
note.en: Principality of Bulgaria, including Eastern Roumelia (governed by the Prince of Bulgaria as Governor-General since 1886): an autonomous tributary principality under the suzerainty of the Sultan (Treaty of Berlin, 1878) until it proclaimed independence on 5 October 1908. Shape copied from the first record of the Tsardom.
